title: Catholic Hymns & Liturgy
summary: A hymn and liturgy app for Nigerian Christians. I implemented its redesign and rebuilt it in Kotlin, replacing the original Java codebase.

caseStudy.overview: An app supporting personal spiritual growth and participation in communal worship.
contribution: Implemented a redesign of the application.
Built the new version in Kotlin, replacing the previous Java code.

decisions.title: Rewrite in Kotlin alongside the redesign
decisions.body: The redesign was delivered as a new Kotlin version rather than layered onto the existing Java codebase.
